description: Reply to an existing email, in its thread. With replyAll the reply goes to the original sender and all To and Cc recipients, except the account's own address

additionalRecipients.description: Extra To recipients added to the default or given To (deduplicated by address)

attachments.description: Files to attach. Total size is capped at 25 MB

items.description: One attachment: give either path or content (base64) plus filename

content.description: Base64-encoded file content, used instead of path

contentType.description: MIME type. Inferred from the file extension when omitted

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient. Required with content; defaults to the file name of path

path.description: A file inside the folder the user set in EMAIL_MCP_ATTACHMENTS_DIR: its name, a path relative to that folder, or an absolute path inside it. Files anywhere else are refused, and path attachments are off when that variable is not set.

cc.description: Cc recipients. Replaces any Cc carried over by replyAll

signature.description: Add the account's signature (default true). Gmail: the signature of the send-as address the mail goes out from, read from Gmail's settings, in Gmail's own markup above any quoted history; a body that already holds one is left alone. Outlook.com, iCloud and IMAP have no signature a client can read, so nothing is added there. The result's `signature` field says what happened

sourceFolder.description: Source folder (required for IMAP/iCloud when email is not in INBOX)

to.description: Replace the default To (the original sender). Use it when the original was sent by you, so the reply goes to the real correspondents instead of back to yourself

name: email_reply
